how_to_verify_measurement: [HR_BPM]: Sit or float quietly in a neutral posture for 5 minutes away from exercise hardware. Ensure your CSA Bio-Monitor smart shirt chest strap is snug, or attach the Tempus Pro 3-lead ECG pads to confirm resting BPM. || [BP_SYS]: Ensure the CSA Bio-Monitor optical sensor is clean, then perform a cross-check using the Tempus Pro automated upper-arm blood pressure cuff positioned at heart level. || [SPO2_PCT]: Warm your fingertips and clip the Tempus Pro optical pulse oximeter probe onto your index finger for 60 seconds while keeping your hand completely still. || [CABIN_CO2_MMHG]: Inspect the portable CO2 monitor near your workstation/sleep berth and compare against the main cabin ECLSS wall display.
recommended_action_protocol: [JOINT COUNTERMEASURE]: 1. Turn on portable module ventilation fans immediately to disperse local CO2 pockets. 2. Check the ECLSS CO2 scrubber status. 3. Rest for 15 minutes in a high-airflow area and re-verify your Heart Rate on the CSA Bio-Monitor. || 1. Relocate to a well-ventilated module and verify ECLSS CO2 scrubbers (<3.0 mmHg). 2. Re-check Blood Pressure using the Tempus Pro arm cuff after 15 minutes of fresh airflow. || 1. Move immediately to an active air duct or don a portable O2 breathing mask. 2. Switch ECLSS air circulation and CO2 scrubbing to high flow. || [HR_BPM - ALERT]: Stop all mission tasks immediately. If experiencing facial fullness or mild headache, apply NASA Mechanical Thigh Cuffs to draw fluid back into the lower extremities. || [SPO2_PCT - ATTENTION]: Move immediately to a well-ventilated cabin module near an active air duct and take 10 deep breaths. || [CABIN_CO2_MMHG - ALERT]: Switch ECLSS CO2 scrubber beds (CDRA/LiOH) to high mode, avoid heavy physical exertion in this module, and relocate crew to a nominal air module.

how_to_verify_measurement: [HR_BPM]: Sit or float quietly in a neutral posture for 5 minutes away from exercise hardware. how_to_verify_measurement: [HR_BPM]: Sit or float quietly in a neutral posture for 5 minutes away from exercise hardware. how_to_verify_measurement: [HR_BPM]: Sit or float quietly in a neutral posture for 5 minutes away from exercise hardware. how_to_verify_measurement: [HR_BPM]: Sit or float quietly in a neutral posture for 5 minutes away from exercise hardware.
